description: A second nonlinear integer factorization obligation that z3 cannot decide in the time bound: the product of five integers each > 1 is constrained to equal a prime (1000003). Fewer variables than k01 but the same prime target, so the factorization search still does not complete in 1.5 s and the solver returns unknown (timeout).
notes: The companion to k01: the same hard nonlinear-integer factorization problem with a smaller variable count. z3's nonlinear integer arithmetic cannot prove unsatisfiability (1000003 does not factor into five integers > 1) within the bound. Distinct from k01 in shape (5 vars vs 6) while remaining a genuine timeout, so the gate exercises two independent hard cases.
